youtube.title: Mozart's friend lent him money. He got paid in songs 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Mozart kept borrowing money from his friend Puchberg. The repayment plan was… creative 🎻

What's the worst IOU a friend ever gave YOU? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1788–1791 a broke Mozart wrote a string of begging letters to his friend and fellow Freemason, the Viennese merchant Michael Puchberg, who lent him well over 1,000 florins. In 1788 Mozart wrote his String Trio Divertimento in E-flat, K. 563, for Puchberg.
